subject: Execution plan for expunction of interaction traces and run-time logs
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@lumincare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Redact interaction traces + logs for LuminCare tenancy

Hi Marcus,

We need to initiate a full redaction of all interaction traces, prompt/response artifacts, and ephemeral runtime logs tied to the LuminCare tenant (tenant id: lumin-7643). The legal team is asking for a clear execution plan, proof-of-wipe, and certificate that the sweep touched:
- Prompt/response artifacts (KV cache derivatives, prompt logs)
- Continuous run-time logs that contain user identifiers or PII (60-day window)
- Any temporary debug traces written to S3 during the last 90 days

They'd like an estimated start date, expected completion time, and a manifest we can attach to the security compliance packet. Can you or someone on ops take ownership and reply with the runbook and evidence you will produce?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Platform Security, LuminCare

--
Note: legal@lumincare.com may follow up with a signed DocuSign.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@lumincare.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redact interaction traces + logs for LuminCare tenancy

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask.

High level plan (summary):
1) Scope verification (today): Priyom will validate the tenant identifiers and list of artifact locations (KV indexes, prompt archives, S3 prefixes).
2) DocuSign approval (once we receive signed approval from LuminCare legal) — required to proceed for customer-facing evidence.
3) Execution window (ops-run): We will run the sweep during a low-traffic window; estimated 2–4 hours for the sweep itself, plus up to 24 hours for downstream index pruning and evidence generation.
4) Proof package: sweep_manifest.csv (file list + hashes), erasure_certificate.pdf (signed by Redwood), and an execution log snippet showing agent run ids (redacted for internal IPs).

Attached is our current wipe runbook (redwood_wipe_runbook_v2.pdf) so you can see the steps we will follow.

Questions for LuminCare:
- Which retention buckets (60-day vs 90-day) should be included?
- Do you require a notarized attestation or is our standard erasure certificate sufficient?

Priyom — can you take lead on scope verification and confirm ETA for the manifest? Kimberly, please stand by in case we need legal liaison or escalation.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Support & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_wipe_runbook_v2.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-13T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redact interaction traces + logs for LuminCare tenancy

Marcus / Kimberly — scope verification update below.

We scanned the tenant id lumin-7643 across the following stores:
- KV cache derivatives: kv-cache-prod (prefix: /tenants/lumin-7643/derivatives) — ~1.2M objects (mostly small)
- Prompt logs: prompt-archive-us-east (prefix: /lumin-7643/prompts/) — estimated 42GB (rolling 60d)
- Runtime debug traces on S3: s3://redwood-ephemeral-us-east/lumin-7643/ — last 90 days contains ~3.4GB (mostly debug jsons)

Recommended execution window: 2026-02-15 02:00–06:00 UTC — low traffic and within agreed maintenance hours. Sweep procedure (ops summary):
- Step A: Snapshot indices for audit (read-only export)
- Step B: Run coordinated deletion jobs: KV-prune (parallel), prompt-archive expunge, S3 object delete with MFA-checkpoint
- Step C: Run index compaction, confirm downstream caches evicted
- Step D: Generate sweep_manifest_20260215.csv with object keys and trunc-hashes, create erasure_certificate_20260215.pdf

I anticipate the sweep itself to run ~3 hours; manifest generation another 30–90 minutes. I will attach the manifest + certificate after completion.

Cc: Marissa Cole for final sign-off of evidence package and release to customer.

--
Priyom Das
Service Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@lumincare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: LuminCare Legal <legal@lumincare.com>
Date: 2026-02-13T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redact interaction traces + logs for LuminCare tenancy

Marcus / Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround. We confirm the 60-day retention bucket for prompts and KV derivatives, and please include the 90-day S3 debug traces as well.

Legal has reviewed and will sign the DocuSign approval this afternoon. The signed packet will include the required permission for Redwood to produce and deliver the sweep_manifest and erasure_certificate to LuminCare security.

Please proceed with the schedule you proposed (2026-02-15 02:00–06:00 UTC).

Sara Kim
Head of Platform Security, LuminCare

--
Forwarded message (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/1234-erasuresig
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@lumincare.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-15T18:42:00-08:00
Subject: Execution completed — LuminCare trace sanitation evidence bundle

Sara / team — execution completed and evidence attached. Summary:
- Start: 2026-02-15T02:07:21Z UTC
- End: 2026-02-15T05:21:09Z UTC
- Scope: KV derivatives (pref: /tenants/lumin-7643/derivatives), prompt-archive (prefix: /lumin-7643/prompts/), S3 ephemeral traces (s3://redwood-ephemeral-us-east/lumin-7643/)
- Total objects deleted: 1,233,412
- Total bytes reclaimed: 46.7 GB

Attachments delivered:
1) sweep_manifest_20260215.csv — object keys and truncated hashes (for privacy we redacted user identifiers in keys where they were present)
2) erasure_certificate_20260215.pdf — signed by Redwood Support & Trust lead
3) docusign-lumincare-erasure-sig.pdf — LuminCare-signed DocuSign approval (copied for your records)

Notes and caveats:
- For any artifacts that were mirrored to cold archives (Glacier-type stores) we have submitted an expunge job — expected completion up to 7 days for full irreversible removal from deep storage. We included Glacier job ids in the manifest when applicable.
- We retain the execution logs (redacted) for 90 days internally for operational review; these are never supplied externally unless requested through an approved audit with NDA.

If you need a notarized attestation, we can provision that as a follow-up (estimate +2 business days).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Support & Trust Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sweep_manifest_20260215.csv, erasure_certificate_20260215.pdf, docusign-lumincare-erasure-sig.pdf
